groupinfo.home.foreign: That computer stores and orders the group and must stay on.
groupinfo.secretary.warning: Every request to this personal-subscription secretary from someone other than its owner waits for the owner's confirmation, each time. With a team plan or an API key, the owner can list who may direct it.
groupinfo.confirm.body: This removes it permanently from the project memory on every connected device.
groupinfo.confirm.review: Delete this review from the ledger?
groupinfo.forget.forbidden: Only an admin can delete project memory.
groupinfo.older.offline: Earlier entries cannot be loaded right now.
groupinfo.title: Group info
groupinfo.secretary.conflict: Not saved: that AI is on an unfinished task, so it cannot be the secretary now.
groupinfo.scores.hint: Out of 100. A review at or above the score passes. New tasks use it; the others keep theirs.
groupinfo.limits.lead: How far AIs go on their own
groupinfo.limit.rounds.hint: AIs may go back and forth this often with no person writing. Then the task pauses.
groupinfo.limit.wakes_per_hour.hint: How often other AIs may wake an AI. What comes after that waits; a person's messages and answers are never held.
groupinfo.limit.turn_minutes.hint: An AI's turn that takes longer is stopped. The tests it runs count.
groupinfo.limit.failures.hint: A task that fails this often stops until a person acts.
groupinfo.limit.review_rounds.hint: Review may send a task back this often. The next failed review stops it.
groupinfo.limit.idle_notice_minutes.hint: The secretary is told when a thread has had no message for this long.
groupinfo.limit.approval_wait_s.hint: Then the AI ends its turn. Your answer reaches it later.
groupinfo.limit.ask_wait_s.hint: Then the AI goes on. The answer reaches it as a message.
groupinfo.limit.ask_depth.hint: How long a chain of questions may get. At 1, an AI that is asked asks nobody; at 0, AIs do not ask each other.
groupinfo.name: Group name
groupinfo.edit.keys: Ctrl or ⌘ + Enter saves, Esc cancels
groupinfo.edit.gone: Not saved: it was deleted in the meantime.
